topNews.text: First River Otter Spotted in the Bronx in 100 Years Along the Bronx River
topNews.excerpt: It was June 23rd when a furry brown arrow shot past a motion-activated camera along the Bronx River and sent conservationists mad with excitement. topNews.text: Man Makes 200+ Trips to Remote Villages to Connect Elders with Their Children Working Abroad
topNews.excerpt: It’s estimated that over 110 million Chinese live and work abroad, which for the family members they leave behind can be heart-wrenching and difficult, above all for the elderly. topNews.text: UN Summit on HIV/AIDS Shows Incredible Progress in Infection Rates, Deaths, Treatment Access
topNews.excerpt: New HIV infections and AIDS-related deaths are at their lowest levels in more than 30 years, a special report released by UNAIDS shows.
